title: Amazon raises FY26 capex to about USD 220 bn as AI, AWS demand surges
description: Amazon has raised its capital expenditure (capex) guidance for FY26 to around USD 220 billion from about USD 200 billion earlier, as strong demand for its Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform and artificial intelligence (AI) services continues to drive investment, according to a Nuvama Research report.

title: Mexico university exams annulled over AI
description: MEXICO CITY -- As educators around the world grapple with the effects of artificial intelligence, Mexico's largest and best-known public university, the National Autonomous University of Mexico, or UNAM, has annulled thousands of exams last month that officials believe may have been completed with the aid of AI.
